verdict.rationale: Letta's "dreaming" feature explicitly uses background subagents to review conversations, consolidate lessons, and update memory autonomously without interrupting active work, with configurable triggers (steps, context compaction) — directly matching the self-directed extraction/consolidation story, and /doctor further audits memory placement/duplication over time. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of extraction quality (community comments raise general skepticism about memory reliability/context poisoning but don't concretely refute the dreaming mechanism), and no benchmark data on salience-detection accuracy.
